profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Google Cloud, AI Infrastructure
profile.summary:
Software Engineer at Google Cloud Platforms.

Demonstrated experience in working with large scale distributed systems, designing and implementing microservices, writing robust, well-tested code, and working in an Agile team environment.

Experienced private computer science tutor and teaching assistant in computer science at Rice University.

Skilled in Python, C++, C, Java, SQL, and MATLAB. Comfortable with frameworks/technologies including Docker, Spring Boot, Django, Flask, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB. Experience in building both HTTP REST and gRPC servers. Industry experience with AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.

positions.title: Private Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
• Instructed clients between ages nine to fifteen in principles of Computer Science including algorithms, data structures, basic application frameworks, and API design.
• Helped clients build small applications including food-delivering web apps, command line tools, and games with AI features.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching Assistant for the following courses:
• Introduction to Program Design
• Fundamentals of Computer Engineering
• Computational Programming in Chemical Engineering

• Taught concepts to students during office hours and assisted with programming assignments
• Provided feedback, graded students' code submissions, and addressed individual student needs.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented a service that runs on thousands of machines in the Azure fleet to assist with machine health telemetry collection.
• Developed an interface to read and interact with NVRAM variables.
•  Implemented services that both poll and stream data from on-machine agents, interpret responses, and upstream telemetry to various data pipelines.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented numerous features, tests, and bugfixes across multiple projects in an enterprise data platform.
•Developed in Java and PostgreSQL, became proficient with Spring Boot, Liquibase, and Docker.
• Integrated as a member of an engineering team using Agile development with Jira, Bamboo and Bitbucket.

positions.title: Production Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed and implemented a chemical batch treatment plan to save Anadarko over $2 MM annually
•	Redesigned and optimized the batch treatment schedule for all Delaware Basin operations
•	Developed current official standard operating procedure to schedule batch treatments

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
-Lead two projects regarding CRISPR/cas9 gene therapy for medicinal therapeutics. 
-Achieved successful excision of the two genes dopa decarboxylase and angiotensinogen. 
-Assisted Dr. Karl Dimiter Bissig with research in metabolic pathway reprogramming with CRISPR/cas9 with the goal of treating Alzheimer's and various types of liver disease.
- Achieved proficiency in advanced lab techniques including plasmid preparation, PCR, miniprep, maxiprep, bacterial transformation, and hydrodynamic tail vein injection
